source.note: No tutorial pixels are copied. Procedural arena art samples the pinned tutorial palette; production tanks are selected, separate Sprite Fusion hull and turret direction sets whose neutral armor and team-signal panels are deterministically finished by declared recipes.

worldLandmarks.rule: explicit nonuniform crops, 4x nearest-neighbour downsample, hard alpha threshold, bottom registration

worldConifers.rule: SHA-pinned source, hard alpha, nearest-neighbour scaling, bottom-ground registration

worldLowCover.rule: SHA-pinned source, bounded edge-contact QA, hard alpha, native-grid crop, bottom-ground registration

worldPickups.rule: explicit grid cuts, 12x nearest-neighbour downsample, hard alpha threshold, bottom registration

worldCoverSprites.rule: Explicit per-sprite crops; nearest-neighbor downsample; hard alpha threshold; bottom registration into padded runtime cells.

worldSandbagSprites.rule: SHA-pinned source, source-edge gutter, hard alpha, 5:8 nearest-neighbour reduction, bottom-ground registration

hexCover.rule: selected basalt top-face pixels sampled into collision-aligned porous rock cover

hexCliffs.rule: opaque-bounds crop, nearest-neighbour fit, meadow top/face palette grade, bottom registration; runtime anchors require solid wall stamps

quantisation.rule: Histogram every opaque pixel of the pinned sources, fold near-duplicates within the merge radius into the more frequent colour, drop anything below the minimum count, keep the most-used entries.

teams.rule: Every team shares one shading ramp: shadow / base / light / highlight. blue and sand are 100% sampled (sand is literally the tutorial tank's hull ramp). red and green use hue-rotated variants where the sampled histogram has no colour at that hue - the sampled greens are all the olive of the ground itself, which would camouflage a tank.

base.rule: sRGB -> HSL, replace H, keep S and L, HSL -> sRGB

light.rule: sRGB -> HSL, replace H, keep S and L, HSL -> sRGB

highlight.rule: sRGB -> HSL, replace H, keep S and L, HSL -> sRGB

outlineStyle.finding: The pinned tutorial sprites do carry a 1px dark border: #2c2839 is the single most common colour in units/tank/down/1.png (159 px), units/infantry/down/1.png (68 px), buildings/turret/1.png (146 px) and buildings/supply-depot/1.png (547 px), and it traces the silhouette.
outlineStyle.applied: #2c2839, 1px, 8-connected, on tanks, projectiles, pickups, crate and wall edges.

exceptions.#423438: Explosion frames 2+ use the tutorial explosion's own dark smoke instead of the sprite outline, matching fx/explosion/3-5.png.
exceptions.#8a7549: Floor markings use a gold/blue paint-edge instead of a hard black border.
exceptions.none: Self-luminous art (explosion frame 1, tracers, the railgun bolt, ricochet pulses, muzzle flashes, sparks, the pickup glow ring) and the HUD chips carry no border; fx/explosion/1.png in the tutorial is likewise a single flat colour with no border.

outlineStyle.difference: The tutorial sprites feather the outermost outline pixel with partial alpha. The generated art keeps hard edges (alpha 0 or 255) so nearest-neighbour sampling at orthographic zoom 2 stays crisp.

map.ordering: Defold tile order: 1-based, left to right, top row first
map.themeIndexRule: ((mapSeed XOR defaultArenaSeed) unsigned) modulo theme count

autotile.bitMeaning: set when the orthogonal neighbour is a concrete wall

map.name: Frontier

tileSource.note: The stub `animations { id: "anim" }` block mirrors main/tutorial-map.tilesource; no tile animations are defined.
